description: Records which QuickBooks customer a matter belongs to, after a person confirms a match (for example from possible_customers on an invoice listing). After linking, invoice listing returns that matter's invoices. Changes nothing in QuickBooks or Asana. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

qbo_customer_id.description: QuickBooks customer Id, usually one of list_invoices possible_customers that a person confirmed.

name: link_qbo_customer
title: Link matter to QuickBooks customer
